## Broadcom CEO reaffirms AI revenue targets unchanged despite Anthropic slowdown push

AVGO's on-record reaffirmation of AI targets directly counters the Anthropic-driven slowdown narrative and is a key validation point for the hyperscaler-capex-to-custom-silicon thesis; any subsequent revision would carry outsized credibility damage.

- AVGO CEO publicly addressed calls from Anthropic to slow AI deployment, stating the company's AI revenue targets have not changed.
- The statement is a direct rebuttal positioning Broadcom as insulated from the AI caution narrative.
- The defense of targets signals continued confidence in custom-silicon demand from hyperscaler customers.
- No specific revenue figures or guidance details are cited in the headline.
